title: Reproduction Analysis
text: After that, Éclair and the others came to a grave behind the mansion of Fiancée and Éclair’s family, in what was now a ruined town, and laid flowers there—though where they’d procured them from, I couldn’t say.
Silence dominated the surroundings. From the main street, the cheerful sound of Filolial-sama’s game of tag drifted over, a small comfort indeed.
“……Once this present turmoil settles, is it truly possible for this land to be restored……?”
Was that a question directed at me?
“It can be done. At least in the future I know of, this place gets restored.”
Fiancée and Father would be the ones to rebuild it.
“Well, Éclair, in your particular case, though, it’s Elephant who ends up shouldering the burden and coming to complain to us about it.”
Éclair furrowed her brow, apparently displeased with my answer.
“Elephant, meaning……?”
“He seems to mean Lady Elmelo. Admittedly, I do think she and Éclair-sama would get along.”
“Does that woman really possess such governing ability?”
“Apparently she’s the adopted daughter of a Siltvelt general who once matched wits with Trash in the past.”
“Lord Janon? Then she is indeed talent of appropriate caliber.”
Elephant was, in fact, quite a capable elephant.
“So you see, Éclair, no matter what happens, it will surely work out in the end.”
“Hmm……”

Éclair listened with an expression that suggested she wasn’t entirely convinced. She then went on into the empty mansion to inspect the interior. Apparently arson had occurred as well, with roughly half the rooms burned down. Perhaps due to looting, the remaining structure was in considerable disarray.
“To think our own kingdom’s soldiers did this……it’s lamentable.”
“No doubt they seized the opportunity to plunder as they pleased.”

Incidentally, human bones were being found here and there throughout the town. It seemed monsters had also been quite prevalent for a time. The scars left by the Waves ran deep indeed. Éclair and Crocodile Man walked through the ravaged mansion together, occasionally lapsing into conversations only the two of them could understand, as though steeped in memory. Then……upon reaching a certain room within the mansion, both Éclair and Crocodile Man’s footsteps came to a halt.
“This is……”

Before a room in a spectacular state of devastation, Éclair appeared to clench her fists in fury. The desk and bookshelves had been smashed apart with what looked like an axe. The destruction had reached such extremes that the walls bore the scrawled words: “Melromarc is a nation of humans—may the demi-humans rot!” Worse still, a portrait of what appeared to be Éclair’s parent, hanging in the room, bore countless slash marks. Even accounting for the ruin of war, the malice etched here was plain and deliberate to an almost obsessive degree. Éclair’s father’s room appeared to have burned down entirely. It was not a place particularly good for one’s spirit.
“Because Father died, these foolish wretches……”
Suppressing her anger, Éclair took her father’s portrait into her hands. She seemed to intend to bring it back as a keepsake. Presumably the painting would be restored later.
“……Well then, let us return.”
“Yes……”
“We absolutely must rebuild this land.”

Éclair seemed to be moving forward with some manner of resolve burning in her chest. Incidentally, a mystery inscribed by Éclair’s parent on the portrait she brought back that day would later lead to another expedition—but that’s a matter for later. And so, Éclair and Crocodile Man’s exploration of the ruins came to an end. What I couldn’t help but wonder was this: perhaps, even down the loop where Father purchased Crocodile Man, they still ended up coming to this same ruin.

Now then……the Filo-tan Project has been proceeding without a hitch, I say. Let me organize here the analysis and future policy that Father and the others worked out during the previous loop. Starting with the elements necessary to construct Filo-tan. As an overarching premise, we prepare an egg that, if hatched and raised normally, would become Sakura-chan. Otherwise, it could never possibly become Filo-tan. Since Sakura-chan and Filo-tan are one and the same existence, no substitute egg will do. Steeling my heart, I endured until the appointed time and entrusted the matter to Father.
“For now, it seems like her eyes change color if I become her master, so I’ll go ahead and be Sakura-chan’s master.”

I recall, word for word, what Father from the previous loop said. Next, make Father the master. The exact principle remains unclear even now, but it seems that among Filolial-sama, the reaction that occurs upon master registration can trigger some sort of change even before hatching. In Father’s case, it seems the hatched Filolial-sama’s eye color turns out different. This was verified through the loops. Without doing this, it was theorized that the result would be a Filo-tan with cherry-blossom-pink eyes.

“And as for the name, I’ll go ahead and request ‘Filo.’ As for me in the very first loop……wrongly accused and having lost faith in humanity, I was only managing to hang in there because Raphtalia-chan believed in me. Being at odds with Motoyasu-kun on top of that must’ve been rough, in its own way……”
Father from the previous loop said this with a somewhat distant look in his eyes.

“In any case, it’d probably be best if you acted somewhat like that version of me. From what I’ve heard, he seemed sullen, but he never went so far as to abandon people—more like curt and unfriendly.”
This too I had already requested of Father.

“What I figure is, Sakura-chan is a pretty easygoing, gentle Filolial, right? I think that personality comes from feeling fulfilled, feeling loved. Apparently it’s naturally a gentle breed to begin with, but according to Gaelion-chan’s testimony, if she’s supposed to be energetic, she probably needs to develop a bit more sense of urgency.”

Most reluctantly, Father has taken to referencing Rival’s nonsense as a point of reference. Frankly, I’d much rather Father be gentle with Sakura-chan……Filo-tan……during her infancy, but since it was said to be necessary, I’ve set my objections aside for now.
“So basically, if I keep up a difficult attitude like that, don’t you think she’ll realize she has to start asserting herself? I think that’s the key to the change.”

Apparently, Father needed to maintain an aloof attitude, making her feel that staying quiet and well-behaved wouldn’t get her what she wanted. Though I do think Father, even when in a bad mood, tends to indulge others somewhat regardless……but perhaps making her believe otherwise is a different matter entirely. They do say that personality formation in early childhood is important, after all. Regardless of the details, it seems that turning gentle Sakura-chan into energetic, lively Filo-tan requires her to learn that degree of self-assertion.

“Now, here’s the important part……compiling information from the loops I know of, and from the results of raising Filolials up until now, it seems that feeding Wave monster meat to a young Filolial might change its fur color even into adulthood.”
And this too came from something they heard from Gaelion-chan, Father and the others explained.

“Timing-wise, that Filo kid was probably eating Dimensional Chimera meat. Apparently there was a loop where Luna-chan turned out white? Thinking it through based on what Gaelion-chan said, I tried to deduce what she must’ve been fed at the time.”

This remains firmly in the realm of hypothesis, but it seems Filolial-sama’s color can change if they eat Wave monsters while young. It was theorized that this would also affect hair color in angel form. Father mentioned it might be worth trying with Fleon-chan too, if experimentation wasn’t possible with Filo-tan, but Fleon-chan is also a Filolial-sama I’d like to see faithfully reproduced if at all possible. ……I raised Fleon-chan in the previous loop without any particular doubts, but I did happen to bring along Wave monster meat as well. Now that I think of it, there was indeed a loop where Luna-chan’s color turned out white. Up until now, I had been raising Luna-chan without giving it much thought—normally she comes out navy blue. It was during the loop when we stayed in Melromarc that Luna-chan turned out white.

……Come to think of it, the period when I was raising Luna-chan overlapped exactly with the period when Filo-tan was growing up. Incidentally, this time around, Luna-chan’s color is navy blue. Her angel form’s hair color is navy blue as well. Now that I think about it, it seems Rival first started hitching a ride on the loops starting from the one where we stayed in Melromarc. One tends to assume it was the loop after that, but apparently not.
